changelog:
- Initial release of scholarPlotSkill: An AI-powered academic figure generator for researchers.
- Supports creation and editing of SCI-standard figures such as line charts, bar charts, heatmaps, neural network diagrams, and experimental flowcharts via natural language commands.
- Integrates with the scholarplot-sci-figure MCP server; requires user API key from figure.thirdme.com.
- Provides high-quality (300dpi or SVG) output links and clear presentation of figure metadata.
- Offers interactive editing of existing figures through precise instructions.
